description: Source code for the AidlConversionAgc1 class implementing Android audio effect parameter handling, specifically for Automatic Gain Control (AGC) effects.

classes.name: AidlConversionAgc1
classes.description: Class handling AGC effect parameters for Android audio effects.

methods.name: setParameterLevel
methods.description: Sets the target peak level in dBFS for AGC.

methods.name: setParameterGain
methods.description: Sets the maximum compression gain in dB for AGC.

methods.name: setParameterLimiterEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the limiter in AGC.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Dispatches parameter setting based on parameter type.

methods.name: getParameterLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current target peak level setting.

methods.name: getParameterGain
methods.description: Retrieves the current maximum compression gain setting.

methods.name: getParameterLimiterEnable
methods.description: Retrieves whether the limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves specified AGC parameter based on type.
